The annual average temperature (K), calculated at
                        a depth of 2 cm below the surface

fields.name: temp_max
fields.description:
The annual maximum temperature (K), calculated at
                        the surface

fields.name: ice_depth
fields.description:
The calculated depth at which water ice would be
                        sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years
                        (m). Notes: If the calculated depth at which water
                        ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per
                        billion years is zero, then water ice is stable to
                        sublimation at the surface. Also, if the
                        calculated depth at which water ice would be
                        sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years
                        is greater than 2.8738 meters, then the exclude
                        value of -999.0 is reported.

diviner-south-prp.parquet.coordinates: source triangle vertices, km; planetocentric positive-east centres; 1737.4 km reference sphere
diviner-south-prp.parquet.timeSupport: annual model statistics; PDS4 start/stop are inapplicable; no inferred observation year
diviner-south-prp.parquet.temperatureMeaning: temp_avg: model annual average 2 cm below surface; temp_max: model annual maximum at surface; Kelvin
diviner-south-prp.parquet.iceMeaning: calculated ice-stability depth, not measured ice occurrence/depth; source -999 excluded when calculated depth exceeds 2.8738 m; zero retained

missingReason.ice_depth: source exclusion: calculated stability depth exceeds 2.8738 m

diviner-south-prp.parquet.quality: only label-declared exclusion applied; no independent validation; no finer spatial support assigned
